cards.name: Takama No Hara

effects.printed_clause: Discard exactly 2 cards including a Spirit, then add up to 2 Spirit monsters with different Levels from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation verifies a two-card discardable subgroup containing a Spirit; resolution discards exactly two as effect, then selects one or two Deck Spirits whose Level class count is distinct and adds/confirms them.

official_references.matched_structure: Ursarctic Departure uses discard followed by multi-card archetype search; subgroup checks enforce composition.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this from GY, target a Spirit you control; it cannot return to hand by card effect until End Phase.
effects.lua_implementation: The selected face-up Spirit receives EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND through the End Phase; this enforces the destination but the core prohibition is reason-agnostic.

official_references.matched_structure: Official movement-control scripts use single-card destination effects and phase resets.

effects.issue: Confirmed as an engine granularity gap: EFFECT_CANNOT_TO_HAND also prevents returning the card as a cost, while the text says only 'by card effect'. The standard API supplies no reason parameter or effect-only destination-prohibition code that can express the narrower rule exactly.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation and GY effect use id/id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed an unresolved reason-filtering limitation in destination prohibitions.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
